session_id.Description: Unique identifier for each session within a participant. Sessions are numbered chronologically by acquisition date.

age_at_visit.Description: Age of the participant in years at the time of the resting-state EEG session.

moca.Description: Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) score at the time of the session.

updrs_part_iii.Description: Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale Part III (UPDRS-III) motor examination score at the time of the session.

disease_duration.Description: Duration of Parkinson's disease at the time of the session.

levodopa_equivalent_daily_dose.Description: Levodopa equivalent daily dose (LEDD) at the time of the session.

state.Description: Participant state during the resting-state EEG recording.

acq_date.Description: De-identified acquisition date for the resting-state EEG session. Dates have been altered to protect participant privacy while preserving the exact intervals between sessions within each participant.

days_since_first_session.Description: Number of days elapsed since the participant's first resting-state EEG session.
